section_description: Named first-party capability systems organize related features inside their parent GoreeCloud applications. They strengthen product identity without becoming separate GoreeCloud Suite applications or replacing platform-wide authorities.

capabilities.name: GoreeCloud Quill
capabilities.description: The advanced typing, writing, editing, personalization, dictionary, clipboard, and intelligent-input capability system inside GoreeCloud Keyboard.

capabilities.name: GoreeCloud Waypoint
capabilities.description: The work-management umbrella for capture, focus, planning, projects, recurring work, collaboration, operations, timelines, history, and archival experiences inside GoreeCloud Tasks.

capabilities.name: GoreeCloud Resonance
capabilities.description: The music capability system for libraries, playback, discovery, mixes, radio, playlists, lyrics, offline access, personalization, interoperability, migration, and preservation inside GoreeCloud Music.

capabilities.name: GoreeCloud Courier
capabilities.description: The provider-independent mail capability framework for mailbox access, inbox experiences, composition, synchronization, search, rules, attachments, and account integration inside GoreeCloud Mail.

capabilities.name: GoreeCloud Beacon
capabilities.description: The DNS capability umbrella for resolution, caching, authoritative zones, filtering, encrypted DNS, DHCP, split-horizon behavior, clustering, administration, identity, insights, and extensions inside GoreeCloud DNS.
